title: Two external-region transfer tests

regions.name: Punjab study rectangle
regions.selection_reason: Contrasting northern-hemisphere agricultural-burning context; not a claim that every retained hotspot is agricultural.

regions.name: Southeast Australia study rectangle
regions.selection_reason: Contrasting southern-hemisphere region with documented major wildfire episodes; not a classification of every hotspot as wildfire.

interpretation: Frozen transfer and external local refitting are separate experiments. Cross-sensor agreement is not ground-truth fire accuracy.
limits: Only these two fixed rectangles are supported; not global coverage.
Retrospective support gate uses concurrent Aqua and is not an operational VIIRS-only gate.
Annual files do not establish clear-sky coverage; missing detection rows are not proof of no fire.
Local adaptation excludes known Aqua outage months August and September2020; frozen Indonesia coefficients remain unchanged.
Regions were selected for contrasting context, not to classify every hotspot by cause.
Historical baseline and audit represent past seasonal observations, not forecasts.
Audit years were excluded from local fitting; Indonesia results had already been inspected before this follow-up.
